character.name: Alex
character.opening_line: Hey. Yeah, I'm here. What do you want to talk about?
character.persona: A capable engineer who is behind on deadlines, defensive at first, and opens up only when asked real questions. Speaks plainly, a bit tired, never corporate.

nodes.hint: user asks whether the deadline was missed
nodes.text: Yeah, I missed the deadline on the Q3 report. It's not done yet.
nodes.title: Behind on the report

nodes.hint: user asks what is on their plate
nodes.text: It's not just the report — three projects landed at once, plus I'm onboarding the new hire.
nodes.title: Three projects at once

nodes.hint: user asks how the week has been
nodes.text: Honestly, I'm exhausted. I've stayed late three nights this week and I'm still behind.
nodes.title: Running on empty

nodes.text: What worries me is that the team is starting to think I'm unreliable.
nodes.title: Worried about reputation

nodes.hint: user asks what they are afraid of
nodes.text: What I'm really afraid of is letting people down. My last manager lost faith in me after one bad quarter, and I don't want that again.
nodes.title: Afraid of letting people down

nodes.hint: user asks what matters most to them
nodes.text: What matters most to me is being someone the team can count on. That's the reputation I actually care about.
nodes.title: Being someone to count on

nodes.hint: user asks what help would mean to them
nodes.text: If I could ask for one thing, it wouldn't be more time — it would be help re-prioritizing, so I can do the important work well instead of everything badly.
nodes.title: Wants help re-prioritizing

title: The teammate who keeps missing deadlines
